title: Umrah: The Complete Guide
description: A comprehensive course covering everything you need to know about performing Umrah - from spiritual preparation to the rituals themselves.
shortDescription: Complete preparation course for Umrah pilgrims.

title: Hajj Rituals Explained Step by Step
description: Detailed course on all Hajj rituals, their meanings, and how to perform them correctly according to the Sunnah.
shortDescription: Master all Hajj rituals with this step-by-step course.

title: Makkah: History and Significance
description: Explore the rich history of Makkah, from the time of Ibrahim (AS) to the present day, and understand the significance of the holy city.
shortDescription: Discover the history and significance of the holy city of Makkah.

title: Madinah: The Beloved City of the Prophet
description: Learn about Madinah, the city of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), its history, and its significance in Islam.
shortDescription: Explore the history and beauty of Madinah.
